summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Electra Battery Materials Corp, a Canadian foreign private issuer, reporting the award of a structural, mechanical, and piping (SMP) construction contract valued at approximately C$12.4 million to Kilmarnock Enterprises for its cobalt sulfate refinery. The filing contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other corporate change. It is an ordinary operational update on construction progress. No deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes are present. The filing is classified as None, as it is a standard current report on business operations.
